name: modern-worker-golden-flow-guard
purpose: Protect the modern production worker baseline from accidental Golden Flow regressions.
rules: Do not modify Golden Flow 110s artifacts.
Do not cherry-pick, merge, or copy Golden Flow files into the modern worker.
Do not modify protected files without explicit Liam GO.
Keep any approved patch minimal and local.
Run the required non-regression tests before creating a worker release.

protected_files.reason: Navigation, followers entry, follow, mute, post-follow likes, return CT, and recovery behavior.
Exact follow detection and follow action safety.
Account session loop, run accounting, caps, cancellation, summaries, and continuation gates.
Modern account_session orchestration, Scheduler path, warmup, and product flow ordering.
Post-follow like and return CT proof regression coverage.
Mute sheet and dismiss proof regression coverage.
Follow target runtime and next-candidate gate coverage.
Runtime cap and safety ceiling coverage.
